description: Offline benchmark for unit, module/component, and controlled integration test generation.

documents.content: Calculator.divide divides integer values and rejects a zero denominator with ArithmeticException. Calculator.add uses exact arithmetic.
A unit test for integer division must assert that denominator zero throws ArithmeticException and should include negative operands.
PricingService collaborates with PriceSource. total must aggregate every price returned by the collaborator and return zero for an empty collection.
Module tests should use multiple collaborator values so truncated aggregation is detected, while remaining inside the module boundary.
UserRepository persists users through JDBC and countByDomain must bind a domain filter in SQL rather than count every stored user.
A controlled integration test should use an isolated H2 database, insert users from at least two domains, and verify filtered database results.
HTTP clients may retry idempotent requests after transient gateway failures with exponential backoff.
Serialization tests validate required JSON properties, enum names, and unknown field behavior.
Time-dependent code should inject a Clock and cover daylight-saving transitions without sleeping.

cases.query: Generate isolated Calculator divide tests for zero denominator and negative operands
Test PricingService total collaboration with multiple PriceSource values and empty output
Verify UserRepository countByDomain using H2 users from two database domains
